name: SENSOSIDES A AND B 12 MG 30 CAPSULES
description: A plant-based laxative indicated for occasional constipation; it helps with bowel movements affected by medication use, poor eating habits, lack of exercise, low fiber intake, or after surgery. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
